```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(spOccupancy)
library(corrplot)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Reload top model for further analysis

```{r}
top_model <- readRDS("top_model.rds")
```

## Posterior checks

```{r}
# Trace plots for convergence
plot(top_model, 'beta', density = FALSE)

# Model validation --------------------------------------------------------
# Perform a posterior predictive check to assess model fit.
ppc.out <- ppcOcc(top_model, fit.stat = 'freeman-tukey', group = 1)

# Posterior summaries -----------------------------------------------------
# Concise summary of main parameter estimates
summary(top_model, level = 'both')
```

# Community occurence plots

## Closed prop

```{r}
# Extract posterior samples
beta0 <- top_model$beta.comm.samples[, "(Intercept)"]
beta_closed <- top_model$beta.comm.samples[, "closed_prop"]

# Create gradient
closed_seq <- seq(
  min(occ_data$occ.covs$closed_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(occ_data$occ.covs$closed_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

n.samp <- length(beta0)
n.x <- length(closed_seq)

# Compute response curve
psi <- matrix(NA, nrow = n.x, ncol = n.samp)

for (i in 1:n.x) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta_closed * closed_seq[i]
  psi[i, ] <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))   # inverse logit
}

# Summarise posterior
psi.mean <- apply(psi, 1, mean)
psi.low  <- apply(psi, 1, quantile, 0.025)
psi.high <- apply(psi, 1, quantile, 0.975)

# Combine into dataframe
df_closed <- data.frame(
  closed_prop = closed_seq,
  mean = psi.mean,
  low = psi.low,
  high = psi.high
)

# Create plot
p_closed <- ggplot(df_closed, aes(x = closed_prop, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Proportion of closed habitat",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Terrain
```{r}
# Extract posterior samples
beta0 <- top_model$beta.comm.samples[, "(Intercept)"]
beta_slope <- top_model$beta.comm.samples[, "scale(slope)"]

# Create gradient on ORIGINAL scale
slope_seq <- seq(
  min(occ_data$occ.covs$slope, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(occ_data$occ.covs$slope, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

# Scale to match model
slope_scaled <- (slope_seq - mean(occ_data$occ.covs$slope, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                sd(occ_data$occ.covs$slope, na.rm = TRUE)

n.samp <- length(beta0)
n.x <- length(slope_seq)

# Compute response
psi <- matrix(NA, nrow = n.x, ncol = n.samp)

for (i in 1:n.x) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta_slope * slope_scaled[i]
  psi[i, ] <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))
}

# Summarise posterior
psi.mean <- apply(psi, 1, mean)
psi.low  <- apply(psi, 1, quantile, 0.025)
psi.high <- apply(psi, 1, quantile, 0.975)

# Combine into dataframe
df_slope <- data.frame(
  slope = slope_seq,
  mean = psi.mean,
  low = psi.low,
  high = psi.high
)

# Create plot
p_slope <- ggplot(df_slope, aes(x = slope, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Slope",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## WDPA

```{r}
# Extract posterior samples
beta <- top_model$beta.comm.samples

# Get WDPA levels
wdpa_vals <- sort(unique(occ_data$occ.covs$WDPA))
wdpa_vals <- as.character(wdpa_vals)

# Identify WDPA coefficient columns
wdpa_cols <- grep("as.factor\\(WDPA\\)", colnames(beta), value = TRUE)

# Intercept
beta0 <- beta[, "(Intercept)"]

# Storage
n.samp <- nrow(beta)
n.wdpa <- length(wdpa_vals)

psi <- matrix(NA, nrow = n.wdpa, ncol = n.samp)

# Loop over WDPA levels
for (i in seq_along(wdpa_vals)) {
  level <- wdpa_vals[i]
  # baseline = intercept
  eta <- beta0
  # add effect if not reference level
  col_name <- paste0("as.factor(WDPA)", level)
  if (col_name %in% colnames(beta)) {
    eta <- eta + beta[, col_name]
  }
  psi[i, ] <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))
}

# Summarise posterior
psi.mean <- apply(psi, 1, mean)
psi.low  <- apply(psi, 1, quantile, 0.025)
psi.high <- apply(psi, 1, quantile, 0.975)

df_wdpa <- data.frame(
  WDPA = factor(wdpa_vals),
  mean = psi.mean,
  low = psi.low,
  high = psi.high
)

# Create plot
p_wdpa <- ggplot(df_wdpa, aes(x = WDPA, y = mean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), width = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "WDPA category",
    y = "Mean community occupancy probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) &
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

# Species association plots

## Residual correlation matrix

```{r}
library(corrplot)

lam <- as.matrix(top_model$lambda.samples)

n.samp <- nrow(lam)
n.sp <- length(dimnames(top_model$y)[[1]])
sp.names <- dimnames(top_model$y)[[1]]

# infer number of factors
n.factors <- length(unique(as.integer(sub("^.*-", "", colnames(lam)))))

corr.sum <- matrix(0, n.sp, n.sp)

for (s in 1:n.samp) {
  L <- matrix(lam[s, ], nrow = n.sp, ncol = n.factors, byrow = TRUE)
  Sigma <- L %*% t(L)
  sd.vec <- sqrt(diag(Sigma))
  Corr <- Sigma / (sd.vec %o% sd.vec)
  corr.sum <- corr.sum + Corr
}

corr.mean <- corr.sum / n.samp
diag(corr.mean) <- 1
rownames(corr.mean) <- sp.names
colnames(corr.mean) <- sp.names

corrplot(
  corr.mean,
  method = "color",
  type = "lower",
  diag = FALSE,
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.6,
  tl.col = "black",
  col.lim = c(-1, 1)
)
```

## Co-occurence plot

```{r}
cooc.sum <- matrix(0, n.sp, n.sp)

for (s in 1:n.samp) {
  z_s <- matrix(z[s, , ], nrow = n.sp, ncol = n.site)
  # joint occurrence across sites
  cooc <- tcrossprod(z_s) / n.site
  cooc.sum <- cooc.sum + cooc
}

cooc.mean <- cooc.sum / n.samp

rownames(cooc.mean) <- sp.names
colnames(cooc.mean) <- sp.names

corrplot(
  cooc.mean,
  is.corr = FALSE,
  method = "color",
  type = "lower",
  diag = FALSE,
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.6,
  tl.col = "black",
  title = "Joint occupancy probability"
)
```
